project.title: Insights into Microbial Diversity of Rice Mill Wastewater through Metagenomic Analysis
project.description: This study explores the microbial diversity present in rice mill wastewater using a metagenomic approach. By analyzing the total microbial DNA, we aim to identify and characterize the bacterial, archaeal, and fungal communities that thrive in this environment. The results will help understand the ecological composition, potential functional roles, and biotechnological applications of microorganisms in rice mill wastewater.
